title: The Ledge Where Silence Has Walls

features.name: the terracotta threshold
features.desc-on-touch: a narrow ledge where the gorge's sides rise vertical—sound is trapped here, bounces trapped, echoes that never escape. silence is not absence: it is pressure with walls.

features.name: the acoustic-trap glyph
features.desc-on-touch: carved into the stone centuries ago, marks where sound was deliberately contained—the old inhabitants understood that silence could be architecture.

features.name: the stone that learned not to echo
features.desc-on-touch: porous and ancient, it has absorbed so many sounds that it no longer returns them. the echo is the stone giving up its own voice.

inscription: the ledge where the gorge taught sound to stop being sound
